title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 413 (Term of office of President, Chairperson and other Members)

content.overview: The President and Members of the Tribunal hold office for five years and are eligible for reappointment for another term. Age limits apply: sixty-seven years for the President and sixty-five for other Members.
content.glance: The President and Members of the Tribunal hold office for five years and are eligible for reappointment for another term. Age limits apply: sixty-seven years for the President and sixty-five for other Members.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 413 (Term of office of President, Chairperson and other Members). The President and Members of the Tribunal hold office for five years and are eligible for reappointment for another term. Age limits apply: sixty-seven years for the President and sixty-five for other Members. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A person who has not completed fifty years is not eligible. The NCLAT is now read with section 417A and the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021.
